نتصالح (form VI)
# نَتَصَالَحُ (nataṣālaḥu) /na.ta.sˤaː.la.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَصَالَحَ (taṣālaḥa)
# نَتَصَالَحَ (nataṣālaḥa) /na.ta.sˤaː.la.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَصَالَحَ (taṣālaḥa)
# نَتَصَالَحْ (nataṣālaḥ) /na.ta.sˤaː.laħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَصَالَحَ (taṣālaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
